examples.title: Example 1: Creating an Appearance Animation for a Component
examples.description:
Directly using animateTo can lead to the issue of ambiguous UI context. To avoid this, obtain the UIContext object using the getUIContext() API and then call animateTo bound to the instance using the animateTo API.
This example demonstrates how to create an appearance animation for a component using the onAppear method.

examples.title: Example 2: Enabling Component Disappearance After Animation Completion
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to make a component disappear after the animation ends.
